title: AnyJev Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.00831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A s

translated_abstract: 类型化决策是在固定选项集合中进行选择，并以概率而非文本的形式返回。当今需要类型化决策的系统通常使用为此专门训练的模型。本报告描述了 AnyJev，它从预训练指令微调语言模型的一次 prefill 中读取类型化决策。该读出机制将答案位置的下一个 token 分布限制在选项 token 上。这种方法存在两个缺陷：模型无论输入如何都会给某些标签分配更高的概率，并且会给选项列表中的某些位置分配更高的概率。AnyJev 在无需梯度更新且不改变参数的情况下修正了这两个问题：它除以从无标签输入估计出的标签先验，并对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转的对数概率取平均。在两个 20 选项任务上，旋转将顺序翻转率分别从 0.33 降至 0.14 和从 0.33 降至 0.18，并在两个任务上提升了全部 11 个模型的准确率。读取每个旋转需要 K 次 prefill。
tldr: AnyJev 无需任何梯度更新或参数修改，通过除以从无标签输入估计的标签先验并对选项列表 K 个循环旋转的对数概率取平均，直接从预训练指令微调语言模型的一次 prefill 中读取类型化决策，有效消除了标签先验偏差和选项顺序位置偏差。
en_tdlr: AnyJev reads typed decisions from a single prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned LLM with no gradient steps or parameter changes, correcting label priors and order-position bias by dividing out an estimated label prior and averaging log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list.
